# Featured Papers

Active biological materials on curved surfaces utilize non-conservative elastic forces to couple internal energy generation with geometric curvature, enabling active shape dynamics and mechanical work extraction.

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [From seawater to pyrenoid – The molecular architecture of the diatom CO2-concentrating mechanism](<https://doi.org/10.1093/plphys/kiag607>)
*Ginga Shimakawa, Onyou Nam, Alexander F Schober, Oliver Mueller-Cajar, Luke C M Mackinder, Yusuke Matsuda* <br>
Bicarbonate transporters, carbonic anhydrases, and a protein-shelled pyrenoid systematically coordinate to import dissolved inorganic carbon, deliver concentrated CO2 directly to Rubisco, and prevent gas leakage to optimize photosynthetic carbon fixation.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

*Henrik Weyer, Ching Yee Leung, Erwin Frey* <br>

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
